`class CircleNodeEffect`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEffect<Node>`](/reference/effects/nodeeffect/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.effect.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [CircleNodeEffect.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/effect/impl/CircleNodeEffect.java)

Cuts what a node draws to the largest disc centered in its bounds.

![A grey square cut into a disc](/captures/catalog-effects-circlenodeeffect.webp)

## Description

The disc takes the shorter side of the node as its diameter: a square image becomes a round avatar.
A [`ShadowNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/shadownodeeffect/) on the same node draws a round shadow, and a [`BorderNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/bordernodeeffect/) outlines the disc.
Its priority is `100`, so its pass runs before a blur and a border.
